body: One jsonl record = one Turn; no merging of assistant records that share message.id (every real assistant record carries exactly one block, 432/602 API messages span several records). Alternative rejected: merge by message.id inside parse, because grouping is a rendering concern for TASK-006 and file order already preserves sequence.

thinking is never deserialized: private RawBlock has no thinking/signature fields, kind "thinking" maps to None and public Block has no Thinking variant. Alternative rejected: Block::Thinking unit variant, because any public variant is something a renderer can match on and it adds nothing TASK-006 needs.

Fixtures generated by planner into scratch/fixtures via scratch/make_fixtures.py (every string redacted, key sets and JSON types kept) and scanned by scratch/scan_fixtures.py; implementer copies them byte-for-byte into crates/transcript/tests/fixtures/. Alternative rejected: implementer extracts from ~/.claude, because codex is sandboxed away from it; planner writing into crates/ directly was rejected to stay inside planner write scope.

ToolResult carries agent_id from record-level toolUseResult.agentId (read as serde_json::Value, since toolUseResult is a string on error results). Alternative rejected: renderer regex over tool_result text "agentId: ...", because that text is prose the model is told not to quote and can change wording.

Turns with zero visible blocks after filtering (thinking-only assistant records, content null/number) are dropped from the Vec. Alternative rejected: keep empty turns, because every consumer would have to re-filter them and they carry nothing renderable.

Use separate minimal turn/title record structs and per-item internally tagged RawBlock variants with #[serde(other)], instead of the plan's shared RawRecord plus flat all-variant RawBlock; throwaway serde probes proved the rejected alternative loses valid data when an irrelevant known field has the wrong type.

Keep PLAN_V2 per-item internally tagged RawBlock with #[serde(other)] Ignored; compiled and tested in scratch/rev2_crate (24 tests, clippy with deny(unwrap_used,expect_used,panic) clean). Alternative rejected: PLAN.md flat all-variants RawBlock (drops a valid text block that has a wrong-typed irrelevant id).

Fixture privacy test checks lowercase substrings "users" + backslash and "users/" plus hand-coded -100 id and bot-token detectors, instead of the PLAN_V2 literal Windows home path, which misses JSON-escaped (doubled backslash) paths in raw fixture text. Alternative: regex dev-dependency, rejected as a new dependency.

PLAN_FINAL embeds the verified reference lib.rs and test files verbatim so the implementer does not re-derive them. Alternative: prose-only steps as in PLAN_V2, rejected because its purity and privacy patterns were ambiguous.

Implement null-tolerant deserialization for known block string fields and cover it with an anonymized fixture. Alternative rejected: leave null fields as a rare accepted drop, because the fix is small and preserves per-item rejection of other wrong types.

Keep BOM-prefixed first-line skipping and image-block dropping unchanged. Alternatives rejected: strip BOM despite the accepted PLAN_FINAL quirk, or add a public image placeholder before TASK-006 renderer scope.
